# three.js (vendored)

Unmodified copies of the three.js 0.187.0 module build, from the npm package
`three@0.187.0` (`build/three.core.js` and `build/three.module.js`):

- three.core.js: SHA-256 613e370f76638fdef83926642bf256dc9615684922de1ce1f63a8583e5d78578
- three.module.js: SHA-256 104f56145899722094556490d787aae0617cc2fc3382f31df02d724ea1aee341

Source: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/releases/tag/r187
Licence: MIT, see LICENSE.

The walkthrough serves these files from its own origin so a presenter can run
it with no network and no third-party host. `tests/test_story.py` checks the
sums above against the files.
